design: One per-port state holds profiles/controllers/borrowed IDs; registry remains accepted task/message/notified owner. verification.historicalOverlap: Counts are nested, not additive; final count is 8 only. Sealed-draft failure probes are red evidence, not extra passing coverage.

verification.artifactLoading: Exact emitted allocated roots/private modules; unchanged supporting owners through source loader. No fallback to historical runtime for current checks.
